question: What manufacturer warranty periods are listed in Table 2A-5 for each retroreflective sheeting type?
model_answer: Direct Answer: Table 2A-5 does not list any manufacturer warranty periods. The table specifies minimum maintained retroreflectivity levels (in cd/lx/m²) by sign color, sheeting type (Beaded Sheeting Types I, II, III per ASTM D4956, and Prismatic Sheeting), and mounting condition — not warranty durations. No warranty information appears anywhere in the provided evidence, so the question as posed rests on a false premise. Standards (mandatory): - "Public agencies or officials having jurisdiction shall use an assessment or management method that is designed to maintain sign retroreflectivity at or above the minimum levels in Table 2A-5." - Per the table's footnote: "This sheeting type shall not be used for this color for this application" (marked with an asterisk for certain color/sheeting combinations). Guidance (recommended): - One or more of the methods described in "Maintaining Traffic Sign Retroreflectivity," (FHWA-SA-07-020, Revised 2013), FHWA, or a method developed based on an engineering study, should be used to maintain sign retroreflectivity at or above the minimum levels in Table 2A-5; signs identified as being below the minimum levels should be replaced. Visual evidence: [Image 1] shows Table 2A-5 in full — its columns are Sign Color, Beaded Sheeting Type (ASTM D4956) I/II/III, Prismatic Sheeting, and Additional Criteria, with cell values expressed as minimum retroreflectivity thresholds (e.g., "W ≥ 250; G ≥ 25"), confirming that no warranty periods are listed. Citations: - Table 2A-5 (p.62) - Section 2A.22 Standard §2 (p.62) - Section 2A.22 Guidance §4 (p.62) - Section 2A.22 Support §3 (p.62)
